Subject: Post-call recap: security & telemetry questions — MediCore

Hi Alex / Priya — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we can keep procurement & legal moving. Please flag anything I missed.

What we heard from you:
- Primary concern: SOC 2 attestation and data residency for PHI-sensitive workflows.
- Compliance surface: need clarity on SOC 2 coverage, DPA/BAA for HIPAA, and whether Redwood’s hosted Console collects any PII or persistent identifiers.
- Product telemetry: you want to understand what the Console and our docs site track (cookies, analytics, admin audit logs) and how to opt-in/opt-out.
- Procurement ask: MediCore will run a vendor security questionnaire + SOW procurement checklist — they asked us to initiate the questionnaire and provide supporting evidence.

Redwood next steps (proposed):
1) Share our up-to-date SOC 2 report and a short summary of scope (expected today).
2) Provide DPA draft and BAA conversation point (we’ll surface our standard language; legal can redline).
3) Outline telemetry/cookie behavior for both the Redwood Console and public docs site — what is on by default, what is admin-controllable, and retention windows.
4) Start the vendor security questionnaire: we’ll upload the initial answers and then schedule a working session with MediCore procurement/legal.

Attachments included: Redwood_Security_Summary_2027.pdf (high-level), link to SOC 2 report in the email below.

Proposed timeline: deliver items 1–3 by Mon 26 Apr; schedule procurement sync for Tue 27 Apr or Wed 28 Apr.

Next steps for you: please confirm procurement contact (if different from procurement@medicore.com) and whether MediCore requires us to sign a BAA before exchanging any sample data.

Thanks — I’ll loop in Monica from Solutions to handle the telemetry questions.

Best,
Naomi Feldman

Thanks Naomi. Helpful recap. A few clarifying items from our side: 

- HIPAA / BAA: We process PHI in a subset of our pipelines. Before we share any sample files, procurement/legal will want a BAA draft or confirmation you’ll sign. Is that something you can surface this week?
- Logs / retention: What’s your default retention window for request logs and admin audit logs? Can retention be configured per-tenant?
- Telemetry: Are cookies/analytics on the public docs site (redwood.com/docs) separate from Console telemetry? We need specifics (types, duration, endpoints called).

I attached our initial security questionnaire so you can see the level of detail procurement expects (MediCore_SQ_Initial.xlsx). We’ll put procurement@medicore.com on the thread for scheduling.

Hi Alex — Monica here (Solutions Engineering). Quick answers in-line to help your procurement team triage before the sync.

On Thu, Apr 22, 2027 at 5:12 PM Alex Gomez <agomez@medicore.com> wrote:
> - HIPAA / BAA: We process PHI in a subset of our pipelines. Before we share any sample files, procurement/legal will want a BAA draft or confirmation you’ll sign. Is that something you can surface this week?

Yes — Redwood can execute a BAA. We typically start with our standard DPA + BAA addendum and accept redlines; I’ll surface a DocuSign link for the DPA draft below. If you'd like a separate BAA doc, Legal can provide one same week.

> - Logs / retention: What’s your default retention window for request logs and admin audit logs? Can retention be configured per-tenant?

Default: request logs (14 days raw, 90 days aggregated telemetry), admin audit logs (90 days by default). Configurable: for Dedicated/Private deployments we support custom retention policies and longer archive retention (subject to contract). Hosted customers can request extended retention as an add-on.

> - Telemetry: Are cookies/analytics on the public docs site (redwood.com/docs) separate from Console telemetry? We need specifics (types, duration, endpoints called).

Summary (high level):
- Public docs site: uses standard analytics (stateless cookies for session metrics, third-party analytics scripts). We publish a cookie table on the docs site and allow opt-out via banner. No customer request content is sent to analytics.
- Redwood Console: collects product usage metrics and (optional) admin audit logs. Console telemetry does not record prompt/response content unless a customer enables debug logging and explicitly opts-in. KV cache and model inputs are never sent to third-party analytics.
- Retention: analytics events aggregated at 90-day default, raw traces 14 days; audit logs 90 days. For Private deployments, audit logging integrates with customer SIEM or S3 for longer retention.

Resources attached/linked:
- Redwood_Security_Summary_2027.pdf (high-level artifacts)
- SOC 2 Type II report (shared via secure drive): https://drive.redwood.com/reports/soc2-2027
- DPA / BAA draft (DocuSign link): https://docusign.com/link/DPA-Redwood-2027
- Console telemetry doc: https://redwood.com/docs/console-telemetry

We’ll start filling MediCore_SQ_Initial.xlsx and set up a working session with procurement/legal. Proposed times: Tue 27 Apr 10:00am ET or Wed 28 Apr 11:00am ET. Naomi — can you confirm which works for them?

Thanks,
